fixes.note: Only reduced, not fixed. In v2 the counter starts at 1890 instead of 1800 (index.html: `1890`, `YR = { v: 1890 }`, tween 1890->1900 from 6.42 s for 0.83 s with power2.out). Frames /tmp/v2s/v2_script_6.40.png to 7.30.png, contact sheet /tmp/v2s/yr_sheet.png: 6.40 'SEKITAR 1890', 6.50 '1893', 6.60 '1895', 6.70 '1897', 6.80 '1898', 6.90 '1899', 7.00 '1900'. A more robust option is the caption loop in build.mjs (about line 369): snap each chunk start to the first energy rise in vo.wav within ±0.3 s of the aligned word start. #t12b '& GANTI SAYUR' (34.59) is keyed to 'ganti' and can stay.

regressions.problem: The new caption DP splits 'yang jauh lebih gampang' ('much easier') after 'jauh'. Read on its own, the chunk 'dengan labu yang jauh' means 'with a pumpkin that is far away'. In a segment about moving across continents that is a real misreading, and it stays on screen for 1.36 s before 'lebih gampang diukir.' resolves it. A milder case is 'Imigran Irlandia sudah' / 'membawanya ke Amerika,', which ends a chunk on the aspect marker 'sudah' and splits 'sudah membawanya'.
regressions.evidence: index.html cap-19 'dengan labu yang jauh' (data-start 30.11, duration 1.36), cap-20 'lebih gampang diukir.' and cap-16 'Imigran Irlandia sudah'. The render frame /tmp/v2s/v2_script_cap19.png (30.61) shows 'dengan labu yang jauh'. Cause: the NOBREAK set in build.mjs (line ~342) does not include 'jauh' or 'sudah'.
regressions.fix: Add 'jauh' and 'sudah' to NOBREAK in build.mjs. I simulated the existing DP with that change (/tmp/v2s/dp.mjs). It gives 'Imigran Irlandia' / 'sudah membawanya ke Amerika,' / 'lalu mengganti' / 'lobak dengan labu' / 'yang jauh lebih' / 'gampang diukir.'. That is 27 chunks, all 2-4 words, and nothing else changes. 'lobak dengan labu' then starts at 'lobak' (29.76), the same moment as the LOBAK title.

regressions.fix: Drop the x translations and centre each face by moving the crop window instead, which never exposes an edge. Set object-position on the panel videos, e.g. #p-turnip{object-position:52.4% 50%} (shifts the content 13 px left) and #p-pumpkin{object-position:48% 50%} (shifts it 11 px right), and tween scale only.
